summary: auth login finds Chromium-based browsers beyond Chrome: Chrome, Chromium, Chrome Beta, Brave, Microsoft Edge, Vivaldi and Arc, in /Applications and ~/Applications on macOS, the usual Program Files/LocalAppData paths on Windows, and PATH names on Linux. findBrowserBinary delegates to detectInstalledBrowser; the login message and errors name the browser found (or list the ones looked for).
reason: A user report: auth login said no Chrome was found on a Mac with only Brave/Edge/Arc or a per-user ~/Applications install, and messages always said Chrome.
markers: looked for Chrome, Chromium, Brave, Edge, Vivaldi and Arc
validated_outcome: Unit tests: darwin candidates include Brave/Edge/Arc/Vivaldi in /Applications and ~/Applications with Chrome first; Windows candidates include Edge and Brave; browserNameForPath names each family; on Linux a PATH holding only brave-browser is found and named Brave, and an empty PATH gives the not-found error listing the browsers. Existing headless-Chrome login tests still pass.
